item.title: Show HN: Flappy Mail, digital letters sent by 8-bit carrier pigeons (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description: Messages USED to take a long time to get anywhere... weeks, days, even months! Now, our texts and calls are delivered in seconds. I built Flappy Mail to re-introduce the friction (and the waiting) that makes snail mail fun... Messages USED to take days... weeks... sometimes even months to arrive. Now, our messages are delivered in seconds. So I built Flappy Mail to bring back some of the waiting that made getting mail fun! You write a letter and a cute 8 bit pigeon carries it to the recipient's city in real time (50mph). It'll take breaks to sleep before delivery. The recipient hears nothing until it lands, and (spoiler!) some pigeons are lost to the ether. There are a few more easter eggs if you poke around, enjoy :) Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50534708 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
